I reported 6 findings on `fees.py`: four correctness bugs, one missing-tests note and one duplication cleanup. I only read the diff against `main` and did not run any code.

1. **`average_fee`** (`fees.py:10`): it raises `ZeroDivisionError` on an empty list, although the docstring promises 0.
2. **`paginate`** (`fees.py:15`): it computes `start = page * size`, but the docstring says pages start at 1. `paginate(items, 1)` therefore skips the first page.
3. **`dedupe_members`** (`fees.py:23`): it dedupes on `name`, but the docstring says identity is decided by email. Two different people with the same name get merged, and one person under two spellings stays duplicated.
4. **`unpaid_members`** (`fees.py:30`): it matches emails exactly, so `A@x.com` and `a@x.com` count as different people. A payment record with no `member_email` key raises `KeyError`.
5. **Tests**: none of the new helpers has a test, so none of the three mismatches above would be caught.
6. **Reuse**: `average_fee` repeats the sum expression from `total_fee` instead of calling it.

I found no `CLAUDE.md`, so the conventions check found nothing to flag.
